name: ClearURLs
description: Automatically removes tracking elements from URLs you send
summary: Removes tracking parameters from URLs you send
notes: Rules come from ClearURLs' data.min.json, downloaded at most weekly and cached; works offline from the cache. URL serialization follows WHATWG rules for the parts the plugin touches (host, default port, dot segments, percent-encoding); exotic hosts such as numeric IPv4 shorthands are not normalized.
